relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: TLR4 recruits myeloid differentiation factor 88 (MyD88) to activate nuclear factor kappa B (NF-κB), promoting the release of inflammatory cytokines and the increased sensitivity of TRPV1
